name: Potatopunk
detailed_description:
FROM THE SOIL WE RISE!

Plant. Battle. Liberate! - The Great Spud Uprising Begins now!

"The oppressors believe us to be simple spuds—let them taste the fury of a rebellion baked to perfection!" - Sir Spuddington III.

In Potatopunk, a unique take on the Tower Offense and Roguelite Auto-Battle genres, you become the commander of a ragtag potato rebellion, send your potato soldiers into glorious, chaotic battle and bring liberty to potatokind. Dive into a fictional future-past Germany to command a dangerously starchy rebellion into potato-powered mayhem!

Do you have what it takes to harness the power to overthrow the government and stop the extinction of potatokind?

Plant, Grow and Harvest your Soldiers!

Your only hope lies in the earth, within the raw spudlings waiting to be magically infused, armed and trained! Assemble and shape your army to your playstyle and the challenge ahead.

Harness the Power of the Earth!

Your runs will rarely be the same! Upgrade your army with better equipment, discover powerful combinations and unique abilities and find the best way to take down your oppressors!

Adapt your Strategy!

Choose whether to stockpile reserves or go all out, explore the options of various factions and use the information you gather between each assault to change up your strategy, evolve your army and learn from your mistakes to become a better commander!

Peel back the Curtain and Unearth the Truth!

The sudden discovery of magical potatoes has brought untold possibilities to the 20th century. Explore their stories, aid in uncovering the strange secrets of their origin and unveil the dark plot at the heart of a government conspiracy.

short_description: Potatopunk is a tactical auto-battler with tower-offense and roguelite elements. Grow an army of rebellious potatoes, send them into chaotic battles, and adapt your strategy with upgrades and new abilities. Fight for potatokind’s survival and uncover a dark conspiracy in an alternate 20th century!

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
